messages:
Maya: Kicking off a controlled router swap for eu-west now. proposal: shift traffic to green pool in 10% increments every 3m. thresholds: p95 <= 220ms, 5xx rate < 0.5%. fallback to blue on breach.
Jon: Thanks — are we pinning model versions on the green nodes or letting router pick latest compatible? want deterministic fallbacks.
Maya: Pin green to model v2.14 for this rollout. blue stays on v2.13. if we rollback we revert routing only (no model changes).
Ciara: I'll watch metrics. can we add a temporary alert: p95 > 240ms OR 5xx > 1% for 1m -> immediate hold + notify oncall.
SRE-Oncall: ack. creating alert now: eu-west.router.p95 > 240ms (1m) and eu-west.router.5xx_rate > 1% (1m). escalation to paging.
Maya: DeployBot, start the staged shift. step=10, interval=180s, hold_at=25% for manual check.
DeployBot: @Maya starting traffic shift: target=green, step=10%, interval=180s, hold_points=[25%]. current=0% -> 10%.
Jon: Quick sanity check: How do we run an immediate rollback if needed? command snippet please.
Maya: Use the routectl helper: ``routectl shift --region eu-west --to blue --percent=100 --reason='rollback'``. also there's a dry-run flag: `--dry`.
Ciara: Noted — I'll keep the canary probes running against /health and the short-tail benchmarks we set (gen latency). if probes show regressions at 10% we'll halt.
SRE-Oncall: If alert fires during ramp, I'll pause and tag infra oncall. if it's manual hold at 25% we'll wait 5m for stability metrics before proceeding.
Maya: Release notes and change log are at https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20-eu-west-swap : includes model pin, rollback steps, and runbook.
Jon: One last ask — add a temporary routing header so downstream logs show `x-deploy-cohort:green` for 1h after full cutover.
Maya: Done, header will be set by router at >0% green. good call for traceability.
DeployBot: shift progressed: 10% -> 20%.
Ciara: metrics look clean at 20%: p95=190ms, errors=0.12%. proceeding.
DeployBot: reached hold point at 25% and paused for manual verification.
Maya: Holding at 25% — give me thumbs when you confirm gen-sanity and cost delta under expected.
Ciara: :thumbsup: gen-sanity pass. cost delta within 1.2% expected.
SRE-Oncall: No alerts so far. proceeding when Maya says go.
Maya: Go for next steps, continue to 100% in same increments. keep alert thresholds active for 30m post-cutover.
DeployBot: Continuing: 25% -> 35% -> 45%.
Ciara: Small spike at 45% in long-tail at one replica, investigating. not breaching threshold yet.
Maya: Hold at 50% if spike persists for 2 mins. otherwise continue.
DeployBot: final step: 90% -> 100%. cutover complete.
Maya: Cutover complete. full green. tagging thread in release notes. if any post-cut anomalies, follow rollback command. great work everyone :tada:
